statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat
The symptoms are concerning for arrhythmia in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service was to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate symptoms with potential ectopic beats or conduction abnormalities over an extended monitoring period
The diagnosis codes submitted were I34.0 and R00.2
The service was denied with denial reason code CO-50
The service was not deemed medically necessary under current coverage guidelines
The clinical criteria for this specific diagnostic modality were not met
